_provenance: Hand-labelled from the source PDF. Single E-size electrical one-line diagram, Howey-in-the-Hills FL WTP No. 3, same opportunity as 98878_1. Tags below were confirmed present in the Document Intelligence Layout content string.
_section_note: A one-line diagram has no document structure. The section index must emit zero nodes for this file; any node is a false positive.
_pairing_note: Four VFD-driven pairs only. SSS-W5 and SSS-W6 drive WELL NO.5 and WELL NO.6 through SOLID STATE STARTERS, not VFDs; emitting them as vfd_motor_pairs is a false positive and the main precision trap in this package. Motor tags are descriptive load names, not tag numbers - the drawing carries no motor tag scheme, which is itself a finding.
_ampacity_hypothesis: Sheet E-07 (98878_1 p9) carries a handwritten '3× 124 Amp 1× 65 Amp', consistent with VFD-H1/H2/H3 at 124 A and VFD-J4 at 65 A. Sheet E-08 carries '2× 124 Amp' for the two well-pump starters. Confirm with the customer before treating as ground truth.

_ocr_artefacts._note: Live example of the corruption TagLexicon.snap exists to repair, found on real customer data rather than constructed.

_other_tags_note: Distribution equipment, not drives. Present so tag precision is scored against what is actually on the sheet rather than against an idealised list.
